1879073526.name: Return to Bree
1879073526.desc: This enables you to quickly return to Bree. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879097206.name: Frog-speech
1879097206.desc: Summons a little frog-friend to brighten your day.

1879146742.name: Mystifying Flame
1879146742.desc: A properly scribed rune can create a flame to confuse your enemies. Greatly reduces threat over time.

1879148406.name: Improved Our Fates Entwined
1879148406.desc: Fates can be deeply linked if the Rune-keeper wishes. Reduce your fellowship's damage, but pay for it with your own morale. Further reduces 10% of all incoming damage and damage will not interrupt your inductions while the Fates are Entwined.

1879157622.name: Taunting Strike
1879157622.desc: A weak melee attack that generates bonus threat.

1879182838.name: Shield-brother
1879182838.desc: A toggle marking an ally as your Shield-brother, making them the target of some of your abilities.

1879191030.name: Dagger Throw
1879191030.desc: This well thrown knife will root an in-bound target.

1879198326.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Spotted Lynx)
1879198326.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208438.name: Red-clad Pony of the Gap
1879208438.desc: A pony bearing the emblem of the sun in red barding.

1879214582.name: Celebration of Skill
1879214582.desc: An impressive movement that restores a significant amount of morale.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215478.name: Shield Tactics
1879215478.desc: Impressive shield movements increase defences.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This Gambit grants immunity to stuns.</rgb>

1879248374.name: Spread of Arrows - Fire
1879248374.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Fire-based projectiles toward your target.

1879272822.name: Sure Strike
1879272822.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.

1879297398.name: Spear Strike
1879297398.desc: A powerful spear strike that damages enemies in front.

1879315062.name: Green-back Cave-claw
1879315062.desc: Summons a green-back cave-claw to help you search for riches!

1879320182.name: Slash (Dual)
1879320182.desc: A powerful swing that deals damage to your enemy.

1879339126.name: Muster in after-battle Osgiliath
1879339126.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to after-battle Osgiliath.

1879418742.name: Facepaint - Flower
1879418742.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a flower pattern.

1879449846.name: Vicious Claws (Dual)
1879449846.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action. Provides additional effects based on your specialization.

1879463030.name: Curious Slug
1879463030.desc: Summons a curious slug to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467254.name: Debilitating Strike
1879467254.desc:
Strike at your opponent's weapon, disrupting their motion.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Disengage further improves Mitigations.</rgb>
<rgb=#ecdd11> Lunge will start a Fellowship Maneuovre.</rgb>

1879470582.name: Mounted Sludge Pot
1879470582.desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge.

1879485430.name: Relentless Maul
1879485430.desc: You rear up and begin to thrash violently, dealing damage to enemies in front of you and healing nearby allies.

1879487478.name: Major Pet Command
1879487478.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879497718.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497718.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506678.name: Guile
1879506678.desc: Strike your enemy with the speed and guile of a spider.

1879508598.name: Aggressive Grodbog Queen
1879508598.desc: Summons an aggressive grodbog queen to accompany you on your adventures.

1879521398.name: Marsh Crocodile Hatchling
1879521398.desc: Summons a fierce marsh crocodile hatchling to accompany you on your travels.

1879528566.name: Balefire Synergy
1879528566.desc: Devoted to Balefire, infused by a Synergy, your target explodes in flame, damaging nearby enemies and afflicting them with an effect corresponding to the devotion of your most recent attack.
